metadata.remarks: Digital Forensics defines the capability to preserve, analyze, and reconstruct security-relevant evidence in a forensically sound manner following security incidents. This pattern supports investigation, accountability, and lessons learned. It deliberately excludes detection logic, response orchestration, and preventive controls.

components.title: Evidence Collection and Preservation
components.description: Forensically sound acquisition and preservation of digital evidence.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Digital evidence is collected and preserved to support incident handling activities.
Evidence preservation supports post-incident lessons learned and improvement.

components.title: Forensic Analysis
components.description: Analysis of preserved evidence to reconstruct events and determine root cause.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Forensic analysis supports incident investigation and impact determination.
Audit and forensic data are analyzed to support incident detection and response.

components.title: Chain of Custody and Integrity
components.description: Maintaining evidentiary integrity and chain of custody.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Chain of custody supports incident reporting, legal review, and external coordination.
Forensic artifacts are protected from unauthorized modification or deletion.
